items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: I used to go dance for Oliver's music. He used to play around here at the Economy Hall.

ctx.x: And would he play in the ballroom or would he just stand outside?

Well, he played, you know, he used to play at home, but after he learned, you know, and he started playing all them different little tunks around him, you know, then he left and he went away. See? Yeah. He left here and went on to Chicago. I believe he left before Oliver did.
